## Download

- **macOS** (Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later): `PigPal-*-macos-arm64.dmg`. Open it and drag **Pig Pal** into Applications.
- **Windows** (64-bit): `PigPal-*-windows-x64.zip`. Unzip it anywhere and run `PigPal.exe`; nothing to install.

Pig Pal records the Waveline Pro's raw Ethernet stream, decoded vitals, notes and audio, and replays sessions in a Waveline-style view. Everything is saved on your computer. To connect the monitor, see [Connect the monitor](https://github.com/thepiglab/pigpal#connect-the-monitor).

## First launch

These builds are not signed with a paid developer certificate, so the operating system asks once:

- **macOS** says Apple could not verify Pig Pal is free of malware. Click **Done**, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway** next to Pig Pal. It opens normally from then on. macOS also asks for microphone access the first time you turn the microphone on in a recording.
- **Windows** SmartScreen may say it protected your PC. Click **More info → Run anyway**. Windows Firewall may ask to allow Pig Pal on private networks so the monitor can connect; allow it.

Offline transcription is optional: download its model once from **Settings → Transcription**.
